name: commission-quote-app
description: Root scripts only. Starts the processes and fans tests out. The code lives in commission-quote-api-mock/ and web/.

scripts.start: concurrently -n mock,web,ui -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm start --prefix commission-quote-api-mock" "npm run start:server --prefix web" "npm run start:client --prefix web"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix commission-quote-api-mock && npm test --prefix web
scripts.test:unit: npm test --prefix commission-quote-api-mock && npm run test:unit --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix commission-quote-api-mock && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix commission-quote-api-mock && npm install --prefix web
